stories.title: Flintshire confirmed for new Youth Hub in UK Government rollout
stories.summary: Flintshire has been confirmed as the site of a new Youth Hub offering employment, skills and wellbeing support to people aged 16 to 24. stories.title: North Wales Police warns against cross-border mega-force
stories.summary: North Wales Police could be merged into a larger force under a UK Government review, councillors heard on Monday, with the force already arguing it should not be pulled across the border into England. stories.title: Shop raided repeatedly but reopens next day, councillor tells police panel
stories.summary: A shop raided around six times by police, trading standards and immigration officers kept reopening the next day, a Flintshire councillor has told the North Wales Police and Crime Panel. stories.title: Flintshire youth violence scheme supported 373 young people in six months
stories.summary: A Flintshire scheme aimed at young people at risk of serious violence supported 373 of them in six months and will run for another year, the North Wales police and crime commissioner has reported. stories.title: Social media to be banned for under-16s under UK Government plans
stories.summary: Children under 16 will be blocked from using social media platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat, YouTube, Facebook and X under plans announced by the UK Government.
